attribution.note: Win rate by input tertile, pick-side relative. |spread| = high-band win rate minus low-band — bigger magnitude = the metric separates winners from losers harder, and deserves weight. Read direction too: a NEGATIVE spread on a should-be-positive factor is a red flag.

kprops.note: Bias = actual minus projection (positive means we under-project). Leans only counted at 0.7+ strikeout edges. Small samples early — a lean record means little before ~100 graded pitchers.

calibration.note: Shadow ledger for learning only — never part of the public record. Official picks stay the only published record.

recommendations: Full-history record across every analyzed game (all tiers, all dates): 224-162 (58.0%), n=386. This is what the correlations below are measured against -- not just the 22 current-model official picks.

Team strength blend edge, before any pitcher/bullpen adjustment (picked side minus opponent): r=0.101 (n=241) -- a modest relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.20 to -0.06): 32-28 (53.3%). Top quarter (0.09 to 0.28): 39-22 (63.9%).
LyDia's own win probability for this pick: r=0.095 (n=386) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.44 to 0.54): 50-46 (52.1%). Top quarter (0.71 to 0.74): 60-38 (61.2%).
Lab Rating's conviction component score: r=0.091 (n=386) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 2.04): 50-46 (52.1%). Top quarter (20.00 to 35.00): 61-37 (62.2%).
Lab Rating's offense component score: r=0.055 (n=386) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 12.55): 57-39 (59.4%). Top quarter (25.00 to 50.00): 62-36 (63.3%).

Size of the price (how big a favorite or underdog this pick was): r=-0.051 (n=380) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (100.00 to 115.00): 51-44 (53.7%). Top quarter (159.00 to 850.00): 60-35 (63.2%).
Lab Rating's bullpen component score: r=-0.051 (n=386) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (1.10 to 6.11): 58-38 (60.4%). Top quarter (12.60 to 20.00): 52-46 (53.1%).
Pick tier (official / value watch / watchlist / pass): official_pick 21-11 (65.6%, n=32) vs. watchlist 36-23 (61.0%, n=59) vs. pass 164-124 (56.9%, n=288) vs. value_watch 3-4 (42.9%, n=7).
Picked the home team vs. the road team: Home 131-81 (61.8%, n=212) vs. Road 93-81 (53.4%, n=174).
These are correlations across LyDia's own analyzed history, not causal proof and not a signal to change any model weight or gate on their own -- human review still required for any actual change.
